observations.behavior: Adds documentation and tests for Replay Vision observation loading and recording player behavior.
observations.code_quote: Observation pages load the result independently of the recording player component. The component loads when the reader expands the recording or selects a citation. Playback remains paused on manual expansion. A citation seeks after the recording bounds and player timestamp are ready. Metadata arriving before snapshots does not consume the pending seek.
